theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_ae_good_points
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet M → μHE[n] M < ∞ → Measurable θ → StronglyMeasurable ζ → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n] < ∞ → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ζ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ᵐ a ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), limsup (fun r : ℝ => μHE[n] (M ∩ closedBall a r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ 1 ∧ Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in M ∩ closedBall a r, ‖θ x • ζ x - θ a • ζ a‖ₑ ∂μHE[n]) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
